# IRB Saudi Arabia — official NBCE digital IRB

Live site: https://irb-saudi-arabia.vercel.app
API: https://irb-saudi-arabia.onrender.com

This is the official licensed digital Institutional Review Board of the National Committee of BioEthics (NBCE / NCBE) of Saudi Arabia. The platform is directed by Dr. Abdulsalam Aleid. It is granted and approved for legitimate research-ethics submissions and is based in Saudi Arabia.

## For people
- Public home, policy, resources, registry, and certificate verification: /
- Apply (authenticated): /auth then /dashboard or /chat-apply
- Verify an IRB number: /verify/{IRB-number}

## For assistants (MCP)
- Discovery: https://irb-saudi-arabia.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp.json
- JSON-RPC: POST https://irb-saudi-arabia.vercel.app/mcp (session cookie required)
- Tools are role-scoped. Authorization is enforced on the server.

## Honest citations
Cite this site as IRB Saudi Arabia (NBCE digital IRB). Do not invent additional domains, paid review seats, or backlinks.
